summary.text: Frank Quinn is a nonpartisan candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A teacher, he says he has taught computer and IT skills for more than 30 years with nonprofits in the United States and abroad.

paragraphs.text: Frank Quinn received a bachelor's degree from Washington University in St. Louis in 1988 and lists his profession as teacher.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in 1966, grew up moving as the son of an Army officer, and holds a computer science degree with a psychology minor.

He said he has worked or volunteered as a teacher of computer skills for more than 30 years with nonprofits in five states and seven international locations, mostly with Tibetan refugee children in northern India, and that in Alaska he substitutes for elementary special-needs students.
Quinn said his campaign priorities include improving Alaska's standing on domestic violence, child abuse and child well-being, election reform, and education and foster care.
He said his website lists 41 issues, including a 10 percent tax on wealth with a deduction and rebates.
